changelog: **Sandbox key on /developers (#1992):** `POST /api/developers/sandbox-key` mints a read-only key (every `*:read` scope, never a write, 24 h, 1000 requests a day) bound to the default org — but only where `sandboxEnabled()` holds: `DEMO_MODE=true` AND a database named `*_demo` (`src/lib/api/sandboxKeyRule.ts`, unit-tested); elsewhere 404, so a key can never be minted against a real tenant. Rate-limited to 3 an hour per address and 200 live keys; the demo seed grants `INTEGRATIONS_API` so the key's reads are not `feature_locked`. Off the demo, the portal links to the demo's developer page.

en: The developer page now hands out a read-only sandbox key on the public demo, so you can try the API against synthetic data without an account.
tr: Geliştirici sayfası artık herkese açık demoda salt okunur bir sandbox anahtarı veriyor; API’yi hesap açmadan sentetik veriyle deneyebilirsiniz.
de: Die Entwicklerseite gibt auf der öffentlichen Demo jetzt einen schreibgeschützten Sandbox-Schlüssel aus, damit Sie die API ohne Konto mit synthetischen Daten testen können.
